proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.title: Americas
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.regionalContext: Tribute Portfolio in the Americas suits owners evaluating independent lifestyle, urban boutique, and resort-adjacent conversions who want Marriott affiliation and Bonvoy participation without a hard-brand prototype reflag.
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.ownerImplication: Screen market tier, conversion PIP scope, and operating complexity before assuming collection economics clear fees—especially in secondary lifestyle markets.
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.fitSignal: Strongest where local character and design narrative support premium conversion, not economy limited-service reflags.
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.confirmationNote: Confirm current brand appetite and development priorities with Marriott before underwriting.
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.sourceBasis: Tribute consumer site + development captures + founder-reviewed positioning (recF0qS9JIZjM3qza, recSLu3N7s84rIKS6); directional only.
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.body:
Independent lifestyle fit

Tribute Portfolio in the Americas suits owners evaluating independent lifestyle, urban boutique, and resort-adjacent conversions who want Marriott affiliation and Bonvoy participation without a hard-brand prototype reflag.

Owner implication: Screen market tier, conversion PIP scope, and operating complexity before assuming collection economics clear fees—especially in secondary lifestyle markets.
Fit signal: Strongest where local character and design narrative support premium conversion, not economy limited-service reflags.
Confirmation note: Confirm current brand appetite and development priorities with Marriott before underwriting.
Source/founder-review basis: Tribute consumer site + development captures + founder-reviewed positioning (recF0qS9JIZjM3qza, recSLu3N7s84rIKS6); directional only.

proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.title: CALA
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.regionalContext: CALA is a meaningful Tribute context for resort, urban lifestyle, and character-led assets—illustrated by captured examples in Puerto Rico (Hotel Rumbao), Barbados (Crystal Cove), Mexico/Riviera Maya (Casa Nizuc listing), Colombia (Loma Medellín), and Peru (Humano Lima).
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.ownerImplication: Underwrite resort operating complexity, seasonal demand, and F&B scope alongside Bonvoy distribution potential—not generic beach-market ADR assumptions.
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.fitSignal: Directional fit for leisure and urban lifestyle conversions where independent identity and Marriott systems both matter.
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.confirmationNote: Use this region as a fit-screening context rather than a count-based footprint claim; confirm project-specific approval with Marriott development.
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.sourceBasis: Tribute openings/momentum property examples + consumer site (recF0qS9JIZjM3qza); illustrative examples only—not performance claims.

proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.ownerImplication: Do not underwrite from this card alone; confirm whether the asset supports lifestyle/resort collection standards and whether Marriott has active development interest for the address.
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.fitSignal: Limited default signal—pursue only when local character, ADR depth, and operator capability align with collection posture.
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.confirmationNote: Use this region as a fit-screening context rather than a count-based footprint claim.
proposedRefinedCopyByRegion.sourceBasis: Cautious founder-reviewed screening language; no sourced MEA property-example package in current Tribute capture set.
